narrative:
The FY2026/27 operating cost plan is GBP 3.90B, up 1.6% and inside the 2% cap. Partner pay and bonus is the largest line at GBP 1.90B and absorbs the National Living Wage uplift.

Two structural savings offset it. Head office simplification removes duplicated finance and reporting work across Waitrose and John Lewis once the PMIS process leaves Excel. The Meter programme retires five legacy data platforms into Snowflake, with Teradata and on-premise SQL Server licence exits landing in H2.

The Margin & Cost Agent has identified GBP 64M of further savings across head office, technology and shop occupancy.

signals.title: National Living Wage uplift confirmed
signals.excerpt: Statutory pay floor rises above most retailer budget assumptions, adding pressure to Partner pay as the largest single cost line.

signals.title: Meter Programme — 5 legacy data platforms into Snowflake
signals.excerpt: Consolidating BigQuery, Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL estates onto Snowflake. Oracle Finance (CDC), Kooper and DIDOS already landed but under-used by Finance.

signals.title: PMIS still mastered in Excel
signals.excerpt: Management income statement, budget, forecast and cash flow live in spreadsheets. Reporting-line definitions exist only in workbooks, so every cycle re-reconciles the same numbers.
